market_question: Abstract FDV above $200M one day after launch?
reasoning: Abstract is an L2 built by the Pudgy Penguins team (Igloo/Frame), with massive community and brand power; comparable L2 token launches (zkSync, Starknet, Scroll) saw FDV in the billions, making $200M a very low hurdle. The main risk is no token launch by end of 2027, but that is unlikely given active development; thus the true probability is 90% vs. the market's 76.5%.
evidence_points: Abstract (Igloo/Frame) combines Pudgy Penguins IP with an L2, giving it a large existing audience for a token launch.
Many L2 tokens launched with FDV >$1B, and $200M is below typical launch valuations even for smaller projects.
The resolution rules define a wide window (through 2027) and a high-liquidity price source, reducing manipulation risk; no launch by 2028 triggers No, a ~10% scenario.
sources_consulted: Market description, general knowledge of crypto token launches (ZK, STRK, SCR), Pudgy Penguins/Abstract announcements
